scope: Deterministic query-cover certificates and actual complete-list controls for two declared affine spaces. Construction is bounded search, not a universal algorithm or minimum-cover proof.

coverage_review.scope: Deterministic query coverage in the declared affine space for every received word. No claim of a smallest query family or guaranteed construction on other spaces.

run.scope: Every nearby member of the certified affine space is returned for this received word. No probability assumption or coverage outside the space.
